cleanTitle: You ask "Where are the black leaders?" WE RIGHT HERE.
segments: Are we going to continue to talk about
this? Where are the Huey P. Newtons?
Where are the Malcolm X's? Where are,
you know, Martin Luther King as we were
speaking of earlier, you know, in his
latter days? Like, where are the people
that are going to go to the forefront
right now and say, "This is not going to
stand. This is not how we will allow you
guys to treat us." Where we at?
>> They're right here.
The men of the Lord that y'all are
looking for
are the same men that y'all call gospel
cubes,
purple power rangers.
The men that are going to be on the
front line for you,
those are the men that y'all  see
in the streets every single day.
The ones that they make skits about.
These are your new leaders.
Malcolm X, Huey P. Newton, Martin Luther
King did wonderful things  for
our people.
They showed that they weren't afraid to
stand up to oppression,
but they also showed that there was a
correction morally and spiritually
needed within our people.
This is why the Lord has called us back
today.
It says in the book of Isaiah chapter 30
and verse 20,
"And although the Lord give you the
bread of adversity
and the water of affliction, yet shall
not thy teachers be removed into a
corner anymore, but thine eyes shall see
thy teachers, and thine ears shall hear
a word behind thee saying, 'This is the
way, walk ye in it, when you turn to the
right hand and when you turn to the
left.'"
How else would you hear that word
unless you were walking on the street
and you heard brothers teaching and they
said, "Hey, change your  life.
Stop committing adultery. Stop
committing fornication.
Do the things that God put  us on
this earth to do. Live righteously."
These are your leaders. They're back.
You just got to listen to them.
